facts.note: Transcript gives the nine o'clock temple striking, the watch-showing, Félix's watch at twenty minutes to nine, and Aurèle scolding him.
Piquet in the salon without a break, the temple striking ten during play, play continuing after, his going out for cigars, and her not looking at the clock when he left.
He asked her to play as he went out; she sat at the piano at once, played until he returned, and stopped when he came in.
A moment after he came back, the hall clock struck eleven.
